_note: Rules for the SIMULATED calendar. The API builds the seed bookings from this file at start-up and on POST /admin/reset. Days are relative to CLINIC_TODAY: 'today', or 'first_<weekday>' = the first such weekday strictly after today. Times are clinic local time (Asia/Jerusalem).
